function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, meaning 48 patients appear more than once in the dataset. The data dictionary states that `sample_seq` indicates assay run number, and the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for the same patient.", "implication": "We must deduplicate the dataset by `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Otherwise, we will be double-counting patients and inflating the sample size. This is required by the population definition ('all patients, after deduplication') and must be done before any aggregation."}
function.name: note_finding
